title: Colors & Color Pickers
summary: ColorEdit3/4, ColorPicker, ColorButton palettes, the important flags, and converting between float arrays, ImVec4 and packed ImU32.

quiz.q: Which widget is best for a clickable palette swatch that applies a preset color?
quiz.explain: ColorButton displays an ImVec4 and returns true when clicked. It never edits data itself.

options: A packed ImU32 used by draw lists
quiz.explain: IM_COL32 packs four 0..255 channels into one 32-bit ImU32, the format ImDrawList uses.

quiz.q: You want a light color that can go above 1.0 (overbright). Which flags?
quiz.explain: HDR removes the 0..1 limit and Float shows the real float values.
